title: Molecular insights into the oil-in-water emulsification and demulsification of guanidino-based CO2/N2 switchable surfactants
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3681-3693
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08773B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wen Ren, Hao Lu, Xingchun Li, Linglan Zhang, Mingdong Zhang, Li Cui, Shuixiang Xie, Ling Lin
MD simulations were used to explore not only the interfacial behavior differences of guanidine-based CO2 switchable surfactant DTMG and its protonated form DTMGH, but also the microscopic mechanism of emulsification/demulsification.
